description: iArnold tool-selection eval. Kinds: tool (write tool after the trainer confirmed), read (read-only tool, no confirmation needed), propose (first request: describe + ask to confirm, no tool), clarify (ambiguous: ask one question, no tool), no_tool (out of scope / unsupported / unknown resource: no tool). `replay` is what a correct model answers; it feeds the CI replay test. The real-model runner (npm run ai:eval) ignores `replay`.
